description: This file defines an abstract REST controller class for the OrangeHRM application, managing common request handling, validation, and response formatting for REST API endpoints in version 2 of the API. It includes method routing based on HTTP verbs, validation, and exception handling.

classes.name: AbstractRestController
classes.description: An abstract base class for REST controllers handling CRUD API operations with request validation, error handling, and response formatting.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the request; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle GET requests.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle POST requests.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle PUT requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle DELETE requests.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for GET requests.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for POST requests.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for PUT requests.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Selects the appropriate validation rule based on the HTTP method.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process the HTTP request, route it to specific handlers, perform validation, and handle exceptions, returning an appropriate HTTP response.
